anime_multiverse.skill.ws_djinn.descript: Extra. Uses the Djinn you hold (bound, or lent to you) from the skill wheel, so its keys are not needed (they still work). It works only while you own it. Modes: Lesser Summon (calls the Djinn as a small manifestation (phase 1)), Half Equip (the Djinn's weapon and its element in your blows (phase 2)), Full Equip (the Djinn's Maso, the full body of it (phase 3); while an Extreme Magic charges it lets go of it), Extreme Magic (from a Full Equip, the Djinn's own Extreme Magic (phase 4)), Step Down (lowers the Djinn one phase (the K key)), Dismiss (sends the Djinn back at once (Shift + the J key)), Draw Rukh (stand still with the vessel on you and draw the Rukh of the place into your magicules; use again to stop (the H key)).
anime_multiverse.skill.ws_beast_will.des: Extra. Uses the Beast Will you carry from the skill wheel, so its keys are not needed (they still work). It works only while you own it. Modes: Acquire Form (starts or ends the Acquire form of the active will (the [ key)), Integrate Form (starts or ends the Integrate form of the active will (the ] key)), Ability 1 (the first ability of the form you are in (the ; key)), Ability 2 (the second ability of the form you are in (the \ key)), Swap Will (makes the next bound will the active one (the = key)), Swap Will Back (makes the previous bound will the active one (Shift + the = key)).
